Necropolis roster planning and reverse-control discussion

guideDetails.statusNote: Legacy progression encounter. The guide is intentionally concise and should be read as preparation, not a modern current-patch solo plan.
attackerProfile: Fast access to damage without depending on long ramp-up.
A plan that does not require Parry-Stun to create every opening.
Comfort against Unblockable Special Attacks and Bane timing.

cheatSheet.watch: Additional immunities reduce common control plans

preparation: Enter expecting Bane to dictate the pace. Preserve a reliable hit to transfer it instead of extending every combo.
Do not assume a Parry-Stun will remain available throughout the fight; verify the Stun before committing.
Treat this as the Act 5.2.6 Collector, not the Abyss or other Collector encounters.

troubleshooting.problem: Bane expires while I am waiting for an opening
troubleshooting.response: Shorten the preceding combo and create distance earlier so you have time to land the transfer hit.

troubleshooting.problem: My control utility stops working late in the fight
troubleshooting.response: Re-check the health threshold and switch to direct damage plus safe Special Attack punishment instead of forcing the same utility loop.

guideDetails.scope: Act 5.2.6 progression preparation only. This does not claim a modern best-team list or a guaranteed solo.

guideDetails.statusNote: Legacy progression encounter. The main value is reading the dormant effect before you apply a Debuff.
attackerProfile: A controllable rotation that can delay Debuffs when the dormant effect is dangerous.
Comfort fighting without automatic Parry openings.
Buff control can help, but it is not treated as an automatic win condition.

cheatSheet.watch: Power Gain, Regeneration, Armor Up or Fury
Parry and Specials can activate the dormant effect

preparation: Before the first Parry, identify the dormant icon. A Debuff can activate the corresponding effect.
Remember that Stun, Special Attack Debuffs and Basic Attack Debuffs all count as Debuff applications.
Use measured combos so an Evade does not turn a full combo into an unnecessary hit.

troubleshooting.problem: Ultron keeps healing after my Parry
troubleshooting.response: You likely triggered dormant Regeneration with the Stun Debuff. Wait for a safer dormant effect or use a non-Debuff opening.
Check whether dormant Power Gain was active when your Debuff landed. Change the timing rather than repeating the same opening.

guideDetails.scope: Act 5.4.6 Ultron preparation only. This guide does not claim that a particular modern Champion trivializes every version of Ultron.

verification.label: Legacy encounter · source-reviewed
verification.note: The dormant-effect loop is retained as legacy progression guidance. No current-client gameplay test is recorded.

attackerProfile: A strong general damage dealer for repeated Wounded windows.
A reverse-control-immune Champion is especially valuable for the final phase, even if reverse-control immunity is not always beneficial earlier.
A usable Striker helps extend Wounded damage windows.

cheatSheet.objective: Ban the required actions and obey Red Light
cheatSheet.watch: During Red Light, stop all inputs including Block

cheatSheet.objective: Read whether the prompt says Grandmaster Says
cheatSheet.watch: Intentionally fail prompts that lack the prefix

cheatSheet.objective: Handle Reverse Controls and rising Power pressure
cheatSheet.watch: Reverse-control immunity can have a phase-specific penalty

cheatSheet.objective: Complete intercept + SP1 + SP2 + SP3 objectives
cheatSheet.watch: Controls can toggle after actions other than Block

preparation: Practice stopping every input during Red Light. Blocking still counts as an input for this mechanic.
Read the entire prompt before acting; Phase 2 depends on whether 'Grandmaster Says' is present.
Keep a reverse-control plan for the final phase. A dedicated reverse-control-immune Champion can save revives there.
Use the Striker during Wounded when safe so the damage window lasts longer.

troubleshooting.problem: I gain failure tokens during Red Light even though I did not attack
troubleshooting.response: Do not move, dash or hold Block. The safe response is no input until Red Light ends.

troubleshooting.problem: Phase 2 punishes me for doing the displayed action
troubleshooting.response: Check the wording. Only obey the action when the prompt includes 'Grandmaster Says'; otherwise the intended response is to fail it.

troubleshooting.problem: The final phase consumes many revives
troubleshooting.response: Use a reverse-control plan and track each remaining objective separately: intercept, SP1, SP2 and SP3.

counters.why: Community Necropolis planning repeatedly values Wiccan for Reverse Controls immunity in the Nameless Grandmaster finale.
counters.strategy: Use your primary damage dealer for earlier Wounded windows if preferred, then preserve Wiccan for the final Reverse Controls objectives.
counters.risks: Reverse Controls immunity can be undesirable in an earlier phase, so this is a phase-specific role rather than a claim that Wiccan is best for the whole encounter.
